domain_specific_rationale: Propagating `attempt_index` into `provider-request.schema.json` is critical to allow provider adapters to construct deterministic, attempt-aware upstream idempotency keys and request tags. Without attempt_index in the provider request contract, provider SDKs risk either reusing idempotency tokens across attempts (causing upstream APIs to return cached results/errors from prior attempts) or generating non-deterministic random tokens that forfeit idempotency guarantees altogether.
capability_impact: Directly supports CAP-03 (Provider Abstraction) and CAP-12 (Autonomous Fault Recovery and Retry Transparency).
residual_risk: External provider APIs that do not accept attempt metadata. Mitigated by adapter layer formatting attempt_index into provider-specific header or metadata fields only when supported, while maintaining internal contract consistency.
